ladderRunnerNodeEnvFinding.symptom: The first R1 attempt, `node scripts/qc/run-gm-two-player-campaign.mjs --group=fixture-smoke ...` with no NODE_ENV, exited 1 before any test ran: '[WebServer] Error [TurbopackInternalError]: Symlink [project]/node_modules is invalid, it points out of the filesystem root' followed by 'Error: Process from config.webServer was not able to start. Exit code: 1'.
ladderRunnerNodeEnvFinding.rootCause: buildRunPlan pins MEKSTATION_E2E_SERVER_COMMAND to 'node server.js' for non-respawning groups (scripts/qc/gm-two-player-campaign-core.cjs:206-208), and runPlan spreads the plan OVER process.env (:285), so the command cannot be overridden from outside. Root server.js computes `dev = process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production' && ...` (server.js:388-389); without NODE_ENV it boots Next in dev, and Turbopack refuses the worktree's node_modules junction.
ladderRunnerNodeEnvFinding.resolution: Prefix the ladder runner with NODE_ENV=production, which the plan does not override, so server.js serves the already-built .next. This is the same substitution U1 recorded (evidence/u1-local-20260916.json, 'Registered group run': `NODE_ENV=production node scripts/qc/run-gm-two-player-campaign.mjs --group=backpressure ...`).
ladderRunnerNodeEnvFinding.scope: A worktree-junction artefact only. On a checkout with a real node_modules the unprefixed command works; the product is not implicated.
ladderRunnerNodeEnvFinding.serverWarningObserved: [WebServer] "next start" does not work with "output: standalone" configuration. Use "node .next/standalone/server.js" instead. - emitted, then the server came up and answered the warm-up probes ('/ answered 200 in 24 ms'), so it is a warning, not a failure.
